grecoil89 1.1.0 - external transform provider
================================================

Added:
- include/grecoil89_provider.h
- src/grecoil89_provider.c
- demo/demo_provider.c
- docs/PROVIDER.md
- docs/PROVIDER_TEST_LOG.txt

Provider modes:
- OFF: provider ignores samples.
- PULL: provider caches transforms for another library to query.
- PUSH: provider invokes another library's set_rotate/set_move callbacks.

Exported channels:
- aim rotate
- camera rotate
- weapon rotate
- weapon move (side/up/back)

Compatibility:
- Existing grecoil89 and grecoil89_bridge APIs remain available.
- No malloc/realloc/calloc/free.
- No heap ownership.
- No float/double.
- Strict C89 and fixed-point Q8.8.
